name: Test vfox.rs

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'crates/vfox/**'
      - '.github/workflows/test-vfox.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'crates/vfox/**'
      - '.github/workflows/test-vfox.yml'

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test vfox.rs
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        rust: [stable, beta, nightly]
        exclude:
          - os: macos-latest
            rust: beta
          - os: macos-latest
            rust: nightly

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Install Rust
      uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
      with:
        toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
        components: clippy, rustfmt

    - name: Setup Rust cache
      uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      with:
        workspaces: crates/vfox

    - name: Run cargo check
      working-directory: crates/vfox
      run: cargo check --all-features

    - name: Run cargo test
      working-directory: crates/vfox
      run: cargo test --all-features

    - name: Run cargo clippy
      working-directory: crates/vfox
      run: cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings

    - name: Run cargo fmt
      working-directory: crates/vfox
      run: cargo fmt --check

  test-minimal:
    name: Test vfox.rs (minimal features)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Install Rust
      uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
      with:
        toolchain: stable

    - name: Setup Rust cache
      uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      with:
        workspaces: crates/vfox

    - name: Run cargo test (minimal features)
      working-directory: crates/vfox
      run: cargo test

  test-all-features:
    name: Test vfox.rs (all features)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Install Rust
      uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
      with:
        toolchain: stable

    - name: Setup Rust cache
      uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      with:
        workspaces: crates/vfox

    - name: Run cargo test (all features)
      working-directory: crates/vfox
      run: cargo test --all-features

  test-docs:
    name: Test vfox.rs documentation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Install Rust
      uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
      with:
        toolchain: stable

    - name: Setup Rust cache
      uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      with:
        workspaces: crates/vfox

    - name: Run cargo doc
      working-directory: crates/vfox
      run: cargo doc --no-deps
